title: Leisure, Screen Time, Arts and Sport
summary: أهم كلمات Unit 2 (Leisure Time): وقت الشاشات، الفنون، الرياضة، ورحلة العجل على النيل — بالمعنى والعيلة والأضداد وتدريب زي Consolidation Review A.

blocks.text: الدرس ده عن إيه؟

text: This page collects the key vocabulary of **Unit 2: Leisure Time**: screen time, the creative arts, sport and physical activity, and the cycling story "Not Exactly a Relaxing Day".

blocks.text: الوحدة دي عن **وقت الفراغ (leisure time)**: بنقضيه إزاي؟ قدام الشاشات، ولا في رسم ومزيكا، ولا في رياضة ومغامرة؟ والكلمات هنا هي اللي بتتكرر في نصوصها وفي مربعات الـ Vocabulary.
كل كلمة معاها معنى إنجليزي بسيط ومعنى بالعربي ومثال. وبعدها عيلة الكلمة (الكتاب نفسه شارحها في الوحدة دي)، والكلمات اللي بتيجي مع بعض، والمرادفات والأضداد، وتدريب بشكل المراجعة.

في الكتاب: **Book 1 · Unit 2** (صفحة 39-65). الدروس: **2.1** Screen Time and Young People (Vocabulary صفحة 44)، **2.2** Creative Arts as Leisure Activities (Vocabulary صفحة 50)، **2.3** Sport and Physical Activity as Leisure (فيه شرح **Word Families** صفحة 56-57)، و**2.4** Not Exactly a Relaxing Day (Vocabulary صفحة 61). وبعدها **Consolidation Review A** (صفحة 66-73) اللي بتسأل في الكلمات دي.
إزاي تذاكر الكلمات دي؟

text: Do not just memorise a list. Learn each word with its **meaning**, its **form** (noun, verb, adjective, adverb), the words that go **with** it, and its **opposite**.

items: اقرا الكلمة والمعنى بالإنجليزي البسيط الأول، وبعدين المعنى بالعربي. الامتحان بيسألك بالإنجليزي، فلازم تفهم الشرح الإنجليزي.
بص على **المثال** وحاول تقول جملة شبهه من دماغك عن حياتك.
اعرف الكلمة دي **اسم ولا فعل ولا صفة**. ده بالظبط اللي بيتسأل فيه في «Complete with the correct form».
احفظ مع كل كلمة **عكسها** و**مرادفها**. المراجعات في الكتاب بتسأل «antonymous meaning» و«could meaningfully replace».
ارجع للكلمات بعد يوم، وبعد 3 أيام، وبعد أسبوع. التكرار ده أحسن من إنك تقعد ساعتين مرة واحدة.

blocks.text: Lesson 2.1 — Screen Time and Young People
الدرس ده عن تأثير الشاشات على الصحة النفسية، وإزاي نعمل **توازن (balance)** بين الأونلاين والأوفلاين.

rows: free time when you are not working or studying
How do you spend your **leisure** time?
receiving something without doing much (watching, scrolling)
Sport is an **active** form of leisure.
to copy something exactly or make something similar
Screens cannot **replicate** a walk in nature.
to affect something badly or stop it from working well
making you feel happy, satisfied and complete
paying conscious attention to the present moment
Be **mindful** of how long you scroll.
limits or rules that show what is acceptable
Set clear **boundaries**, such as no phones at dinner.
to move back or away from people or activities
Some heavy gamers **withdraw** from their friends.
causing a strong need to keep doing or using something
Some apps are designed to be **addictive**.
an uncomfortable feeling of nervousness or worry
Heavy social media use is linked to **anxiety**.
a health condition where gaming controls a person's life

blocks.text: Lesson 2.2 — Creative Arts as Leisure Activities
الدرس ده عن فوايد الرسم والمزيكا والكتابة للعقل والمشاعر والشخصية.

rows: a state of complete absorption in a meaningful task
When I paint, I enter a state of **flow**.
giving all your attention to something
Flow means complete **absorption** in a task.
being involved or interested in an activity
Thirty minutes of creative **engagement** reduces stress.
related to thinking, understanding and learning
the ability to change or adapt easily
real and genuine, not false or copied
Art gives teenagers a space for **authentic** self-expression.
a place or situation where an activity happens
Art is a safe **arena** for exploring who you are.
a practice session before the real performance
The choir had three **rehearsals** before the concert.
Calligraphy is a beautiful form of **self-expression**.
working together towards a shared goal
The arts teach us to **embrace** failure.
traditions and culture passed down from the past
Arabesque design connects us to our **heritage**.

blocks.text: Lesson 2.3 — Sport and Physical Activity as Leisure
الدرس ده عن فوايد الرياضة الجسدية والنفسية والاجتماعية، وليه مراهقين كتير بيبطلوا يلعبوا.

rows: any movement of the body that uses energy
Teenagers need 60 minutes of **physical activity** a day.
Many teenagers are **inactive** because of screens.
to take part in an activity
Everyone can **participate in** the school match.
involving competition, or wanting to win
You don't have to play **competitive** sport to stay fit.
related to the mind and feelings
the ability to control your feelings
the ability to keep going for a long time
to continue trying even when it is difficult
the chance or right to use something
Not everyone has **access to** sports facilities.
that must be done because of a rule

blocks.text: Lesson 2.4 — Not Exactly a Relaxing Day
دي قصة الراوي اللي صاحبه أقنعه يروح رحلة عجل على النيل. الكلمات بتوصف **مشاعره وهي بتتغيّر**.

rows: to demand firmly that something happens
My friend **insisted** that I join him.
to shine with a soft, slightly moving light
The Nile **shimmered** in the morning sun.
As the morning **wore on**, the sun grew stronger.
to find it hard to move at the same speed as someone
I **struggled to keep up** with my friend.
one push of the pedal when cycling
I took one more **pedal stroke** instead of stopping.
needing no effort, or looking very easy
having a strong will to do something
At the turning point he felt **determined**.
a proud feeling after doing something difficult
Finishing the trip gave me a **sense of achievement**.
You are more **capable** than you think.

blocks.title: حيلة للحفظ
items: اعمل **كارت** لكل كلمة: الكلمة على وش، والمعنى والمثال وعكسها على الضهر.
قسّم الكلمات زي ما الكتاب مقسمها (درس درس)، لأن كل درس ليه موضوع وده بيسهّل الربط.
استخدم 3 كلمات جديدة كل يوم في جملة عن نفسك، حتى لو جملة بسيطة.

blocks.text: عيلة الكلمة (Word Families)

text: **Word families** are groups of words that come from the same root but are different parts of speech: noun, verb, adjective and adverb.

blocks.text: الكتاب في درس 2.3 (صفحة 56) بيقول إن الـ word families هي كلمات ليها **نفس الجدر (root)** بس نوعها مختلف، ومثاله: action / act / active / actively. معرفتها بتخليك تفهم كلمات جديدة بسرعة وتكتب الشكل الصح. دي أهم عيلات الوحدة:
إزاي تعرف تختار الشكل الصح؟ **بص على الكلمة اللي قبل الفراغ واللي بعده**:

rows: بعد a / an / the / my / this أو بعد صفة
بعد الفاعل، أو بعد to، أو بعد can / should / must
قبل الاسم، أو بعد is / are / become / feel / seem
بيوصف فعل أو صفة (إزاي؟ قد إيه؟)، وغالبًا آخره -ly

blocks.text: كلمات بتيجي مع بعض (Collocations)

text: A **collocation** is two or more words that are often used together, like **take responsibility** or **raise awareness**. Using them makes your English sound natural.

blocks.text: الـ collocation يعني «كلمات متجوزة»: بتمشي مع بعض دايمًا. مثلًا بنقول **take** responsibility مش **do** responsibility. لو حفظتهم كده كتلة واحدة، كتابتك هتبقى أقوى وهتعرف تكمّل الفراغات بسرعة.

rows: Teenagers **spend** seven hours a day **on** screens.
**Set boundaries** like no phones before bed.
**Take a break from** your phone every hour.
**Find a balance between** online and offline life.
In a state of flow, you **lose track of time**.
An orchestra **works towards a shared goal**.
The race gave her **a sense of achievement**.

blocks.text: Prefixes و Suffixes في الوحدة

text: A **prefix** comes at the start of a word and changes its meaning (un- + realistic = unrealistic). A **suffix** comes at the end and often changes the part of speech (aware + -ness = awareness).

blocks.text: الـ **prefix** حتة بتتحط **في أول** الكلمة وبتغيّر **معناها** (غالبًا بتقلبها للعكس). الـ **suffix** حتة بتتحط **في آخر** الكلمة وبتغيّر **نوعها** (من صفة لاسم، أو من اسم لصفة…). دي أسهل طريقة تعرف بيها نوع الكلمة من غير ما تكون حافظها.
مرادفات وأضداد (Synonyms & Antonyms)

text: A **synonym** has the same or a similar meaning (fragile = delicate). An **antonym** has the opposite meaning (mindful ≠ careless).

blocks.text: المراجعات في الكتاب بتسأل سؤالين مشهورين: «The underlined word has an **antonymous** meaning to…» يعني **عكسها** إيه، و«Find the word in the text that could **meaningfully replace**…» يعني **مرادفها** إيه من القطعة. الجدول ده بيجهزك للاتنين.
كلمات بتتلخبط في بعض

items.ar: **-ed** للإحساس اللي جوا الشخص، و**-ing** للحاجة اللي عملت الإحساس ده. نفس الفكرة: bored / boring, satisfied / satisfying.

items.en: He is **addicted** to gaming. · Gaming can be **addictive**.
items.ar: **addicted** = الشخص المدمن، و**addictive** = الحاجة اللي بتعمل إدمان.

items.en: I **enjoy** painting. · Painting gives me **enjoyment**. · Painting is **enjoyable**.
items.ar: enjoy فعل، enjoyment اسم، enjoyable صفة. وخلي بالك: بعد enjoy بييجي **-ing**.

items.en: The team played **competitively**. · The **competition** was hard.
items.ar: الظرف competitively بيوصف الفعل played، والاسم competition بييجي بعد the.
leisure = وقت الفراغ، و pleasure = متعة. الكلمتين شكلهم قريب.

items.en: I **participate in** sport. · I **take part in** sport.
items.ar: الاتنين نفس المعنى. وخلي بالك من حرف الجر **in**.

blocks.text: الكلمات في فقرة واحدة
اقرا الفقرة دي وطلّع الكلمات الجديدة اللي عليها **bold**. حاول تفهم كل كلمة من الجملة اللي حواليها (meaning in context).

text: My **leisure** time used to be completely **passive**. I would **spend** hours **on** my phone, and the endless videos often **interfered with** my sleep. Last term, I decided to **set boundaries**: no screens after ten o'clock. I also **joined** the school drama club. The **rehearsals** were long, but the **collaboration** with my classmates was truly **fulfilling**, and acting gave me a safe **arena** for **authentic self-expression**.

Then my cousin **insisted** that I try running with him. At first I **struggled to keep up**, and I was **exhausted** after ten minutes. However, I **kept going** and built my **endurance** week by week. When I finished my first five-kilometre race, I felt a real **sense of achievement**. I have learned that a balanced life needs both rest and effort, and that I am more **capable** than I thought.

blocks.text: المعنى ببساطة: الكاتب كان بيقضي وقت فراغه كله على الموبايل، وده كان بيبوّظ نومه. فحط قواعد لنفسه، ودخل نادي تمثيل، وبعدين ابن عمه أصرّ إنه يجري معاه. في الأول تعب جدًا، بس كمّل لحد ما حس بالإنجاز. **لاحظ** الكلمات اللي بتوصف التحول من passive لـ active.

blocks.title: أشهر الأخطاء (غلط ← صح)
items: I enjoy **to paint**. ← I enjoy **painting**. (بعد enjoy دايمًا -ing)
The film was very **bored**. ← The film was very **boring**.
Gaming **interferes** my sleep. ← Gaming **interferes with** my sleep.
Many students do not **participation** in sport. ← do not **participate** in sport. (بعد do not فعل)
Sport is **compulsive** at school. ← Sport is **compulsory** at school. (compulsory = إجباري)
I felt a **sense of achieve**. ← a **sense of achievement**. (بعد of اسم)
He made it look **effortful**. ← He made it look **effortless**. (لو قصدك سهل)

blocks.title: إزاي تجاوب في الامتحان
items: لما تشوف (word) بين قوسين، اسأل نفسك: **قبلها إيه؟** a / the ← اسم، to / can ← فعل، is / feel ← صفة، فعل عادي ← ظرف -ly.
صفات **-ed / -ing** بتيجي كتير: الشخص ← -ed (interested)، الحاجة ← -ing (interesting).

لو السؤال «Find the word in the text that could meaningfully replace…»: الكلمة اللي في السؤال بتكون **شرح** للكلمة اللي في القطعة. دوّر في القطعة على كلمة **من نفس النوع** وفي **نفس الفقرة** اللي السؤال بيقول عليها.
في قصة 2.4 الكلمات بتوصف **مشاعر الراوي**: confident ← relaxed ← uncertain ← tempted to quit ← determined ← satisfied. ممكن تيجي في سؤال «How did his feelings change?».

blocks.text: إزاي بييجي في الأسئلة؟
الأسئلة في الكتاب والمراجعات (Consolidation Reviews) بتيجي بالأشكال دي. شوف إزاي نحل كل نوع خطوة بخطوة:
**النوع 1: Meaning in context**

text:
The orchestra held two **rehearsals** before the concert. What does rehearsal mean in this context?
a. a written review  b. a practice session before a performance  c. a competition  d. a public concert

blocks.text: **الإجابة: b**. «قبل الحفلة» يبقى أكيد **تدريب / بروفة**. (d) هي الحفلة نفسها مش اللي قبلها.
**النوع 2: Complete with the correct form**

text: Creative hobbies improve cognitive ______ and help people adapt to change. (flexible)

blocks.text: **الإجابة: flexibility**. بعد الصفة cognitive محتاجين **اسم**. ونحوّل الصفة flexible لاسم بـ -ity.
**النوع 3: Find the word in the text that could meaningfully replace…**

text: Text: "Drama gives students a safe space where they can share genuine feelings." Which word from the list could replace **genuine**?  authentic / arena / cognitive / rehearsal

blocks.text: **الإجابة: authentic**. genuine صفة معناها حقيقي، والصفة الوحيدة اللي بنفس المعنى في القايمة هي authentic. arena و rehearsal أسماء، وcognitive معناها عقلي.
تدريب
حل الأول في كشكول، وبعدين دوس **Show answer** وشوف الإجابة والسبب.
**A. Choose the correct answer from a, b, c or d.**

items.q:
1. When Salma paints, she forgets about time and gives the work all her attention. She is in a state of ______.
a. withdrawal  b. flow  c. fatigue  d. anxiety
items.a: **b. flow** — الاندماج الكامل اللي بيخليك تنسى الوقت.

items.q:
2. Rules such as "no phones at the dinner table" are examples of screen-time ______.
a. rehearsals  b. arenas  c. boundaries  d. heritage

3. Some apps use autoplay so that users find it hard to stop. These apps are designed to be ______.
a. addictive  b. authentic  c. cognitive  d. compulsory

4. "As the afternoon **wore on**, the heat became unbearable." This means the afternoon ______.
a. ended suddenly  b. passed slowly  c. became cooler  d. started
items.a: **b** — wear on للوقت لما يعدّي ببطء.

items.q:
5. Omar did not want to admit defeat, so he ______.
a. gave up  b. called a taxi  c. kept going  d. withdrew
items.a: **c. kept going** — كمّل. الباقي معناهم إنه استسلم.

items.q:
6. Many teenagers have no ______ to sports clubs because of cost and location.
a. access  b. flow  c. arena  d. endurance
items.a: **a. access** — إمكانية الوصول. خلي بالك من **access to**.

blocks.text: **B. Complete the sentences using the correct form of the word in brackets.**

items.q: 7. Young people find sport more ______ when they choose it freely. (enjoy)
items.a: **enjoyable** — بعد more ومع find + شيء + صفة.

items.q: 8. Students who participate ______ in clubs make more friends. (active)
9. The ______ of TikTok has changed the way teenagers communicate. (popular)
items.a: **popularity** — بعد The وقبل of يبقى اسم.

items.q: 10. After the long ride, the narrator felt ______ but satisfied. (exhaust)
11. Online interaction can be ______ if it is used wisely. (benefit)
12. Art lessons encourage creative ______ among students. (express)
13. The coach tries to ______ players who are losing interest. (motivation)
items.a: **motivate** — بعد tries to فعل في المصدر.

blocks.text: **C. Read the text, then find words in the text.**

text: When Hassan started secondary school, he spent most evenings gaming alone in his room, and slowly he began to withdraw from his old friends. His mother did not ban the games. Instead, she helped him agree on clear limits: one hour a day and never before homework. Hassan then signed up for the school football team. The training was tough and he nearly quit in the first week, but he decided to persevere. By the end of the term, he described football as the most satisfying part of his week, and his marks had improved too.

items.q: 14. Find a word that means **boundaries**.
15. Find a word that means **fulfilling**.
16. Find a word that means **joined**.
17. Find the antonym of **give up**.
18. Find the antonym of **easy**.
19. Find the antonym of **join / engage with**.

blocks.text: **D. Choose the antonym / the correct word.**

items.q:
20. "Watching series all day is **passive** leisure." The antonym of passive is:
a. inactive  b. active  c. relaxing  d. sedentary

21. "His friend made the long ride look **effortless**." The underlined word has an antonymous meaning to:
a. easy  b. simple  c. difficult  d. smooth

22. "PE should be **compulsory** every day." The antonym of compulsory is:
a. required  b. optional  c. obligatory  d. necessary
23. Choose the correct word: The film was so (bored / boring) that I fell asleep.
24. Choose the correct word: Screens cannot (replicate / interfere) the feeling of sitting by the Nile.
items.a: **replicate** — يعمل زيها بالظبط. interfere محتاجة with ومعناها يعطّل.

blocks.title: ملخص الدرس في سطرين
items: Lesson 2.1: **replicate, interfere with, fulfilling, mindful, boundaries, withdraw, addictive, anxiety**.
Lesson 2.2: **engagement, cognitive, flexibility, authentic, arena, rehearsal, flow** · Lesson 2.4: **insisted, wore on, struggled to keep up, shimmered, pedal stroke, sense of achievement**.
Word families: **participate → participation**، **compete → competitive → competitively**، **enjoy → enjoyment → enjoyable**، **flexible → flexibility**.
صفات **-ed** للإحساس و**-ing** للسبب (exhausted / exhausting). وبعد enjoy / avoid / suggest ← **-ing**.
أضداد مهمة: passive ≠ active · effortless ≠ difficult · compulsory ≠ optional · persevere ≠ give up · authentic ≠ fake.
